reviews.x: This lip butter hydrates lips well, the smell is also amazing, the taste not so much but that didn’t even bother me. What I found crazy is that I have had it for a week ( 7 days today) and yes I have used it quite a bit but there is so little product left. For this price point, I expect a lip balm to last me at least one whole winter season, not two weeks!

reviews.t: Only good if you order from actual company
reviews.x: Let me first point out - I absolutely LOVE this product. Not an exaggeration when I say I can’t stand being without it. But please do yourself a favor and order this from Sol de Janeiro directly. The first one I ordered directly from them was amazing and lasted for many, many months (and I use it so many times a day). The 2nd one I ordered was from amazon and it literally lasted me 2 whole weeks. So worth waiting the few extra days and having this ship from the actual company.... otherwise you’l

reviews.t: Very small amount of product in large tube!
reviews.x: This is one of the best lip moisturizers I've ever used. I've had dry lips my whole life & have tried every product on the market at some point. I love the feel of it. It has a very smooth texture & is very moisturizing, without having an oily feeling to it. The only reason I didn't give this product 5 stars is because of the amount you get in the tube. The tube is about 3 1/2" tall and 1" wide. Much larger then chapstick or other lip balm tubes. However, there is only about 1" of pr

reviews.t: Smells amazing and feels great but the amount you get in ...
reviews.x: Smells amazing and feels great but the amount you get in the giant tube is terrible, especially for the price! The picture I attached is of an empty chapstick.
Doesn’t smell like the original Bumbum cream, I thought it would because of the company’s signature smell. But a good lip balm but not worth the price and not a huge fan of the smell.

I’ve Had this product before and loved it. After purchasing this one I was confused. Seems like a fake product to me bc it just dried out my lips. Gave them no moisture and was even rough to put on, like a dried out gas station chap stick. Maybe I just got a flawed product but still Disappointed

I Love this lip balm. It's very smooth and moisturizes for hours. The larger size is perfect for applying. It provides a nice sheen. It is not glossy like lipgloss. The smell is divine, reminds me of fresh baked cookies or cookie dough. The smell isn't intrusive and the smell does not linger. It does not have a taste so it does not interfere with eating or drinking while you have it on your lips. I have been using this product for nearly 3 months. I still love it. The only negative is the high c

reviews.t: This is an absolute Holy Grail!
reviews.x: I am a chapstick hoarder and am always looking for the holy grail chapstick that actually works on my chronic dry and peeling lips. This chapstick is that holy grail!!! Makes my lips feel instantly smooth and soft and for the first time in the 18 years of having horrible peely lips, my lips are super soft, completely healed, and no peeling at all!!!! Im on my 4th Sol de Janeiro Brazilian kiss lip butter and have thrown away all my other 57 chapsticks that didnt work for me.

reviews.t: Amount of Product Seems Deceiving, But...
reviews.x: For anyone complaining about the amount of product in this... this lip butter contains 6.2 grams. A traditional Chapstick brand lip balm in a tube and even Blistex at the drugstore has 4.25 grams. The lip butter tube is a lot wider than Chapstick, so it appears to have less product when really it contains more than what you’d typically get for a lip balm in a swivel tube. Of course it’s more expensive, but that shouldn’t come as a surprise if you choose to buy a lip balm at Sephora (I purchased

reviews.t: Wonderful lip balm but smells different
reviews.x: I bought this lip balm because I'm absolutely head over heels for the scent of the Bum Bum Cream (in addition to the cream I also have the shower gel and the body spray..that's how obsessed with it I am) but I was disappointed to find that this doesn't smell the same. It smells really good, it's just missing a few notes that the other products have. It mostly smells like vanilla with maybe a slight hint of caramel. It's very moisturizing, I love how it feels on my lips, and overall it is a high
The tube is a bit large but it smells amazing and leaves my lips so soft!

I am absolutely obsessed with this product.  It has a toasty, buttery, honey toffee smell that is absolutely divine and I cannot get enough of it.  And it's one of the best moisturizing lip products I've ever used.  I've only been using it for a week (I apply it before I go to bed) and am already seeing a huge difference.  I had been using cocoa butter vaseline, but that only ever seemed to just sit on top of my skin, but not provide any real moisture.  This stuff soaks in immediately, and leave

Absolutely loooove this lip butter! Use it everyday, it’s winter, and is a must have! Goes on smoothly and lasts, leaves my lips silky and moisturized for a good portion of the day. Huge plus is the scent, it’s to die for!

reviews.t: Sol de Janeiro is the best no more chapstick or even gloss this does it all..
reviews.x: no more chapstick this is the creamiest ever smells awesome & i already purchased more....Yes it came in on time too and I will repurchase it too.The smell to me is a bit caramel & vanilla.The size is great as you don't have to reply as much so it is awesome..

Works well but does not last for as long as i would hope for the price point.  Love the smell and taste not that I’m eating it but you know. I like the all natural ingredients. Big plus for something I use constantly throughout the day.
LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this lip balm.  My whole family uses it and loves it.  It moisturizes and treats so that the moisture lasts beyond when you actually still have it on your lips.  Will be rebuying!
Weirdly large tube. Like the size of the cardboard in a toilet paper roll. Hard to use as a lip product.
Worth every penny. Very hydrating. Will definitely purchase again.

This is a great product.. the ingredients are great, it moisturizes well and feels good on the lips. And I understand that most of the time, you get what you pay for. But wowza, the tiny amount of product in this huge tube for $18 dollars! Seriously, one tube lasts 7-10 days, at the most. I'm fortunate to be able to afford this, but the amount of plastic used for such a tiny amount of product makes me feel a little guilty. Please, Sol de Janeiro, you worked so hard to produce a fabulous product.

Works okay as a lip balm, but  has a rebound effect and has to be constantly re-applied or your lips get drier than they were before. Also don't let the size of the tube fool you, it is not the size of the stick inside the tube. Only half of the tube actually has product in it. Doesn't last that long. For $18 I expect a full tube of product not half a tube. It isn't a fluke, I had purchased 3 of these, all were only half full. Won't be buying anymore. I also don't like scented lip products.

I feel like chapstick might even be more moisturizing than this. Unless you warm it up for a long time it seems like I can't get much product actually onto my lips. Smells amazing of course but I don't think it's worth the price at all. Plus I don't get why it needs to be so obnoxiously large and I don't have small lips. Not a huge fan of this lip balm.

reviews.t: Great scent. Poor longevity of lips feeling moisturized
reviews.x: I wanted to love it so so much. And I’ll still use it.  1) not very pocket friendly. 2)I do love the smell! 3) I find myself reapplying way more than with others.  I feel it dries my lips out real quick.

reviews.t: Works wonderfully. It’s just a slightly odd gingerbread tasting so ...
reviews.x: Works wonderfully. It’s just a slightly odd gingerbread tasting so I removed 1 star because I did not expect that. Not a fan of the taste, but a huge fan of what it does for my lips.
I ordered 2 as stocking stuffers. One was fine but the other one was all melted and basically unusable. Make sure you open immediately and inspect the product.
My most favorite chapstick EVER!! Just not worth the money. The chapstick is deceiving and has very little in the container. So sad and expensive!

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the scent, describing it as amazing and divine.
Many reviewers find the product moisturizing and smooth, leaving lips soft.
A common complaint is that there is very little product for the price, with the large tube seeming deceiving.
Some reviewers are disappointed that the scent differs from the original Bum Bum cream.
A few reviewers question authenticity or report the product dried out their lips.
